name: zabbix_api_call
description: Call the configured Zabbix JSON-RPC API. Read-only operations are low risk; mutation operations require the dedicated zabbix_apply approval flow.

function.name: zabbix_api_call
function.description: Call a documented Zabbix JSON-RPC method against the configured server. Use zabbix_apply for mutations after approval.
